title: Hemorrhagic shock
summary: A rifleman was hit by fragments from a grenade several minutes ago. A buddy slowed the leg bleeding with his hands but he has lost a lot of blood. He is pale and confused. You are the platoon medic.
objectives: Stop the leg bleeding (tourniquet first, then dressings)
Gain IV access early, while blood pressure still allows it; use the IO if the IV fails
Restore volume: compatible blood first, saline as a bridge
Measure blood pressure and monitor SpO2
Blood volume above 5.1 L at the end (the patient can wake)
